_meta.source: OPPEIN 2026 pricing (standard + GOLA) merged into prior box list
_meta.notes: Prices are OPPEIN dealer LIST. JMRC dealer cost = list * (1 - 0.58). Standard line: pb/ply by tier (essential..elite). GOLA line: flat.gola_urban / flat.gola_prestige = door price + GOLA box (single box option). Pick a GOLA tier to switch a project to the GOLA line.
